steps.text: Ray block: Katherine can only be at r5c10 or r6c10, and those tiles all lie on one sightline. Whichever one Katherine takes, the whole stretch is watched, so nobody else can stand on r4c10, r5c10, r6c10, r7c10. Eliminated → Arthur: r4c10 · Eleanor: r5c10 · Frederick: r4c10, r5c10, r6c10, r7c10 · Gideon: r4c10, r5c10, r6c10, r7c10 · Hector: r4c10 · Lydia: r7c10.

Frederick was east of Imogen. Imogen is in column 4 at the earliest, so Frederick must be in columns 5–10. Eliminated → Frederick: r1c1, r1c2, r1c3, r1c4, r2c2, r2c3, r2c4, r3c1, r3c2, r3c3, r3c4, r4c1, r4c2, r5c1, r5c2, r5c3, r6c1, r6c2, r6c3, r7c2, r7c3, r7c4, r8c1, r8c3, r9c1, r9c2, r9c3, r9c4, r10c1, r10c2, r10c3, r10c4.

Katherine was exactly one column east of Arthur. Katherine can only be in column 10, which leaves Arthur column 9. Eliminated → Arthur: r2c2, r2c10, r3c1.

Katherine was north of Eleanor. Katherine is in row 5 at the earliest, so Eleanor must be in rows 6–10. Eliminated → Eleanor: r5c8.

Gideon was in the same room as Katherine, so both must be in a room they can both still reach (Billiards). Eliminated → Gideon: r1c1, r1c2, r1c3, r1c4, r1c5, r1c7, r1c8, r2c2, r2c3, r2c4, r2c6, r2c7, r2c8, r2c10, r3c1, r3c2, r3c3, r3c4, r3c5, r3c7, r3c8, r4c1, r4c2, r4c7, r5c1, r5c2, r5c3, r6c1, r6c2, r6c3, r7c2, r7c3, r7c4, r7c5, r7c8, r8c1, r8c3, r8c5, r8c8, r9c1, r9c2, r9c3, r9c4, r9c5, r9c8, r9c10, r10c1, r10c2, r10c3, r10c4, r10c5, r10c8, r10c10.

Eleanor was alone with someone with black hair, and Eleanor is pinned to the Library: that room holds exactly two people, Eleanor and someone with black hair. So Cyril cannot be there. Eliminated → Cyril: r7c2, r8c1, r8c3, r9c2.

The blindspot law: r6c2 cannot be a hiding spot (Eleanor was alone with someone with black hair in the Library), so someone must watch it. Only Eleanor can still see it, so Eleanor must stand on r6c1, r7c2. Eliminated → Eleanor: r8c1.

The blindspot law: r8c1 cannot be a hiding spot (Eleanor was alone with someone with black hair in the Library), so someone must watch it. Only Josephine can still see it, so Josephine must stand on r9c1. Eliminated → Josephine: r7c3, r8c3, r9c2, r9c3.

Josephine — “was standing on a carpet runner and was north of Lydia”. The clue fits 5 tiles; r7c3, r8c3, r9c2, r9c3 are out of sight of r8c1, which only Josephine can watch. Only r9c1 is left. Place Josephine at r9c1; Josephine's sightlines now watch 7 tiles.
Josephine was north of Lydia. Josephine is in row 9 at the earliest, so Lydia must be in row 10. Eliminated → Lydia: r8c8, r9c8, r9c10.

Ray block: Lydia can only be at r10c8 or r10c10, and those tiles all lie on one sightline. Whichever one Lydia takes, the whole stretch is watched, so nobody else can stand on r10c8, r10c9, r10c10. Eliminated → Dmitri: r10c9 · Frederick: r10c8, r10c10.

Cyril — “was beside a pillar”. The clue fits 7 tiles; r3c3, r4c2 are out of sight of r5c3, which only Cyril can watch; r7c2, r8c1, r8c3, r9c2 are in the Library, which holds only Eleanor and someone with black hair. Only r5c3 is left. Place Cyril at r5c3; Cyril's sightlines now watch 7 tiles.
Exactly one person was beside a chair. Cyril is placed beside a chair, so nobody else can be beside any chair. Eliminated → Frederick: r6c7, r7c6 · Gideon: r6c7, r7c6.

The blindspot law: r4c2 cannot be a hiding spot (exactly one person was beside a chair), so someone must watch it. Only Hector can still see it, so Hector must stand on r2c2. Eliminated → Hector: r2c10, r3c1.

Hector — “was beside a wine rack”. The clue fits 6 tiles; r1c9, r3c9 are watched by Arthur either way; r2c10, r3c1 are out of sight of r4c2, which only Hector can watch; r4c10 is watched by Katherine either way. Only r2c2 is left. Place Hector at r2c2; Hector's sightlines now watch 6 tiles.

The blindspot law: r6c1 cannot be a hiding spot (Eleanor was alone with someone with black hair in the Library), so someone must watch it. Only Eleanor can still see it, so Eleanor must stand on r6c1. Eliminated → Eleanor: r7c2.

Eleanor — “was beside a bookshelf. She was alone with someone with black hair”. The clue fits 6 tiles; r5c8 is not south of any tile left for Katherine; r5c10 is watched by Katherine either way; r6c9 is watched by Dmitri either way; r7c2 is out of sight of r6c1, which only Eleanor can watch; r8c1 is out of sight of r6c2, which only Eleanor can watch. Only r6c1 is left. Place Eleanor at r6c1; Eleanor's sightlines now watch 5 tiles.
Katherine was north of Eleanor. Eleanor can reach row 6 at most, so Katherine must be in rows 1–5. Eliminated → Katherine: r6c10.

Katherine — “was standing on a rug, was north of Eleanor and was exactly one column east of Arthur”. The clue fits 2 tiles; r6c10 is not north of any tile left for Eleanor. Only r5c10 is left. Place Katherine at r5c10; Katherine's sightlines now watch 3 tiles.
The blindspot law: P. H. Obia can only be hiding on r1c1. Nobody may stand where they would see it. Eliminated → Blair: r1c4, r1c5 · Frederick: r1c5 · Imogen: r1c4, r1c5.

The blindspot law: r7c2 cannot be a hiding spot (Eleanor was alone with someone with black hair in the Library), so someone must watch it. Only Frederick can still see it, so Frederick must stand on r7c5. Eliminated → Frederick: r1c7, r1c8, r2c6, r2c7, r2c8, r2c10, r3c5, r3c7, r3c8, r4c7, r5c7, r5c8, r6c8, r7c7, r7c8, r8c5, r8c6, r8c8, r9c8, r9c10, r10c5, r10c6, r10c7.

Frederick — “was east of Imogen”. The clue alone allows 74 tiles, but every one except r7c5 is already ruled out — watched or occupied by Josephine; not east of any tile left for Imogen; watched by Katherine either way; out of sight of r7c2, which only Frederick can watch; watched by Dmitri either way; watched by Arthur either way; beside a chair (Cyril already is); in sight of r1c1, which must stay dark; watched by Lydia either way. Place Frederick at r7c5; Frederick's sightlines now watch 6 tiles.
Frederick was east of Imogen. Frederick can reach column 5 at most, so Imogen must be in columns 1–4. Eliminated → Imogen: r1c7, r1c8, r2c6, r2c7, r2c8, r3c5, r3c7, r3c8, r4c7.

Imogen — “was in the Parlor”. The clue alone allows 13 tiles, but every one except r3c4 is already ruled out — watched or occupied by Hector; not west of any tile left for Frederick; in sight of r1c1, which must stay dark. Place Imogen at r3c4; Imogen's sightlines now watch 9 tiles.

Arthur — “was beside a wine rack”. The clue fits 6 tiles; r2c2, r2c10, r3c1 are not one column west of any tile left for Katherine; r3c9 is watched by Imogen; r4c10 is watched by Katherine either way. Only r1c9 is left. Place Arthur at r1c9; Arthur's sightlines now watch 4 tiles.

The blindspot law: r7c6 cannot be a hiding spot (exactly one person was beside a chair), so someone must watch it. Only Gideon can still see it, so Gideon must stand on r7c7, r8c6, r10c6. Eliminated → Gideon: r5c7, r5c8, r6c8, r10c7.

Gideon — “was in the same room as Katherine”. Place Gideon at r10c6; Gideon's sightlines now watch 9 tiles.
What if Lydia stood on r10c10? Without following any clue further, r1c1, r1c3, r1c5, r5c8 could never be watched. So Lydia cannot be on r10c10. Eliminated → Lydia: r10c10.

The blindspot law: r6c7 cannot be a hiding spot (exactly one person was beside a chair), so someone must watch it. Only Blair can still see it, so Blair must stand on r2c7, r4c7. Eliminated → Blair: r2c6, r2c8.
What if Blair stood on r4c7? Without following any clue further, r1c1, r1c3, r1c5, r2c6 could never be watched. So Blair cannot be on r4c7. Eliminated → Blair: r4c7.

Blair — “was in the Parlor”. The clue alone allows 13 tiles, but every one except r2c7 is already ruled out — watched or occupied by Arthur, Imogen, Hector; in sight of r1c1, which must stay dark; out of sight of r6c7, which only Blair can watch; ruled out by a coverage check. Place Blair at r2c7; Blair's sightlines now watch 11 tiles.
What if Dmitri stood on r8c9? Without following any clue further, r1c1, r1c3, r1c5, r9c10 could never be watched. So Dmitri cannot be on r8c9. Eliminated → Dmitri: r8c9.

Dmitri — “was in column 9”. The clue fits 7 tiles; r1c9, r2c9, r3c9 are watched by Arthur either way; r6c9, r8c9 are ruled out by a coverage check; r10c9 is watched by Lydia either way. Only r9c9 is left. Place Dmitri at r9c9; Dmitri's sightlines now watch 5 tiles.

Every suspect is placed and no two of them see each other. Exactly 3 open tiles are still dark: r1c1, r1c3, r1c5. Their clues seat O. B. Scuro on r1c3; P. H. Obia on r1c1, so S. H. Adow is hiding on r1c5!
